what_they_did: scRNA-seq + snRNA-seq multiome; identified 985 HIV-1 RNA+ cells among 4,435 CD4 T cells; volcano DGE of RNA+ vs uninfected CD4; pathway enrichment; chromatin accessibility in RNA+ naive vs memory CD4
relevance: THIS IS THE ANALYSIS LESLEY IS PROPOSING, already done in adults. Establishes the method and the comparison. They state naive CD4 T cells are susceptible in early infection, possibly via dysfunctional antiviral signalling in resting cells.
implication: Our DGE design is defensible and has precedent — but it is NOT novel in adults. Novelty must come from the infant setting, and we must cite this.

study: Divergent HIV-infected naive and memory CD4 clones in children (JCI, 2025)
cohort: 8 children with perinatal HIV, aged 5-11, on ART from 1.7-17 months
what_they_did: FACS-sorted naive and memory CD4; proviral counting, intactness, integration site analysis. Median 4.7% of LTR-containing naive CD4 had intact-consistent genetic elements; infected expanded clones in both subsets
relevance: CRITICAL FOR THE NOVELTY CLAIM. Concludes naive CD4 T cells are an important and distinct reservoir in children with perinatally acquired HIV.
implication: 'Naive CD4 as a reservoir in children' is ALREADY PUBLISHED. Lesley's framing that no one has shown this needs narrowing — see the gap analysis.

study: Naive vs memory proviral quantification in perinatal HIV (PLOS Pathogens, 2026)
what_they_did: Intact and defective proviral quantification plus integration sites in sorted naive and memory CD4
relevance: Found the MAJORITY of proviral genomes in memory CD4, with clonal expansion. Notes the naive-cell measurement risks contamination from memory cells despite stringent gating.
implication: A counterweight: in older perinatal cohorts memory dominates. Also flags exactly the contamination concern a reviewer will raise about our 4 cells.

cohort: Infant rhesus macaques, breast-milk transmission model
what_they_did: Quantified intact SHIV DNA across CD4 subsets under ART
relevance: Naive CD4 harboured intact provirus and were a major contributor to blood and lymphoid reservoir size — described as striking against the adult memory dogma.
implication: The animal-model precedent for the infant-specific naive claim. Strengthens biological plausibility; also means the idea is not unprecedented.

study: Accelerated CD8 T cell maturation in infants with perinatal HIV (PMID 38706858, 2024)
what_they_did: scRNA-seq of the infant T cell compartment; reduced naive, increased effectors, hyper-expanded CTL cluster in HEI
relevance: This group's own prior work and the direct antecedent of the current manuscript.
implication: The infant scRNA-seq platform is established here. An HIV RNA+ analysis extends it rather than starting fresh.

study: Single-cell markers of the HIV-permissive cell (PMC5658171)
cohort: Adult CD4 T cells, in vitro
what_they_did: scRNA-seq of non-infected CD4 from high/low permissive donors; permissiveness tracked TCR-driven activation; surface biomarkers (CD25, CD298, CD63, CD317) enriched infection up to 28-fold
relevance: Permissiveness is an activation-state property in adults, and hyper-permissive cells downregulated interferon-induced genes and restriction factors.
implication: Gives a concrete hypothesis to test in our RNA+ cells: are interferon-stimulated genes and restriction factors LOW in them? Testable with 4 cells as a descriptive observation, not a statistic.
